name: Indicator Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Indicator Ventures (indicatorventures.com), an early-stage investment firm with offices in New York, Boston and Washington DC; general partners Jon Struhl (New York), Geoff Bernstein (Boston) and Baiyin Murphy (Washington DC); portfolio includes Dandy, Databento, Beacon Biosignals, Makini and Retrocausal. Not Indicator Capital or any other similarly named fund.

stages.snippet: Never too early. We've invested in a founder and an idea. If you're already raising your Series A, we're probably not your fit.

leads.snippet: Whether we lead, co-lead, or join the round, we show up when you need us

thesis_text.value: Early-stage firm backing founders at the idea stage, before a Series A, across healthcare, industrial automation, fintech and emerging tech. It leads, co-leads or joins rounds, writes $1-5M initial checks, and deliberately keeps a smaller portfolio so it can work closely with each company.
thesis_text.snippet: We deliberately invest in fewer companies so we can be the first call when something's broken

stated_sectors.snippet: Early-stage investment firm Healthcare Industrial Automation Fintech Emerging Tech

accepts_cold_inbound.snippet: Just email us. First name @ indicatorventures.com. Keep it short, tell us what you're building, attach the deck. Warm intros are nice but not required.
